documents.title: Book Closure For The Purpose Of 34Th AGM

analysis.summary: Kernex Microsystems (India) Limited submitted its investor presentation for FY 2026-27, highlighting its operational capabilities, financial performance, and market opportunities in railway safety systems such as Kavach. The company reported standalone Q1 FY27 revenue of ₹502.03 crores and a total order book of ₹5,174 crores with a balance order book of ₹3,487 crores. Furthermore, management outlined strategic business diversification plans into digital infrastructure, traffic management, and simulators alongside capital and banking limit enhancements. Kernex Microsystems reported strong financial growth for Q3 and 9M FY25, driven by significant increases in revenue, EBITDA, and profit after tax. Management outlined details regarding ongoing TCAS projects, upcoming bids, production capacities, and execution timelines across various railway zones.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian Railways adds approximately 5 new locomotives daily, continuously growing the national rolling stock asset base.
demand_outlook.quote: Expanding Fleet Baseline: Indian Railways adds ~approx 5 new locomotives daily (~1,900+ per annum), continuously growing the national rolling stock asset base.

demand_outlook.claim: Mandatory regulatory tailwinds require 100% of newly manufactured rolling stock to be outfitted with ATP or Kavach modules prior to commissioning.
demand_outlook.quote: Mandatory Regulatory Tailwinds: Per Mandate 100% of newly manufactured rolling stock must be eventually outfitted with (ATP/ KAVACH) modules prior to commissioning.
